convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'KPrmSt' custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position open/close logic, money management, and new bar detection

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal time stamping
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA processes signals

other_exits: Buy closed when Ma1[1]<Ma2[1] (opposite signal), Sell closed when Ma1[1]>Ma2[1] (opposite signal)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects between fixed lot (LOT) and deposit fraction modes; MM=0.1 is interpreted as 0.1 lots when LOT, or as percentage/fraction in other MarginMode modes - exact modes defined in TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses SignalBar=1 (previous bar) for crossover detection: Ma1[1]>Ma2[1] AND Ma1[0]<=Ma2[0] for long (buffer 0 crosses above buffer 1 on the signal bar, confirmed by relationship on current bar). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean inputs that can independently disable long entries, short entries, short closes, or long closes. GlobalVariableDel_ on deinit suggests the TradeAlgorithms library tracks a global variable for position state. Recount flag triggers re-evaluation on the same bar if CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: KPrmSt is a custom indicator without available Python equivalent - must reverse-engineer or port the KPrmSt indicator logic separately. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose/GlobalVariableDel_/CIsNewBar - all must be reimplemented. Crossover logic uses CopyBuffer with SignalBar offset: compares buffer values at index [1] vs [0] where [1] is SignalBar bars back and [0] is SignalBar-1. The conditional position sizing (MMMode enum) requires understanding the LOT/percentage/fraction modes from TradeAlgorithms.mqh. SL/TP are in points (integer), need to convert to price subtract/add: SL_price = entry - StopLoss_*_Point, TP_price = entry + TakeProfit_*_Point. Deviation is in points for slippage control.
